summary: The permission check now works on hosted environments and hands you a ready script to fix what is missing.

new.title: A ready script to fix permissions
new.text: When the engine lacks a permission, the Overview banner shows a ready-to-run PowerShell script with a Copy button. A Global Administrator runs it once.

fixes.title: The permission check works when hosted
fixes.text: On hosted environments the check always said permissions could not be checked. It now checks the engine's permissions and says why if it cannot run.

fixes.title: Access map shows the whole path
fixes.text: Selecting a permission group on the Access map now lights its whole path, from the people through to the permissions.
